messages:
elaine: Planning note 1: we need a rollout + rollback ladder for the tenant-priority routing feature. Objective: steer high-value tenants to Dedicated while ensuring zero-customer-outage and clear cost/quality telemetry.

mike: Who counts as high-value? Is that an ARR tag or usage?

elaine: Combination. Primary list = top 15 ARR accounts; secondary = opt-in beta tenants. We'll use metadata tag `customer.labels:priority=high`.

sanju: Proposed progression (very conservative): pilot (0.5%) -> narrow (2%) -> small (10%) -> broad (50%) -> full (100%). Each stage has a minimum observation window of 12h (pilot/narrow) or 24h (small/broad).

tess: What are the gating signals? I want concrete thresholds we can alert on and auto-revert.

mike: Gate set suggestion: p99 latency delta <= 12% AND error rate delta <= 0.2% AND token-cost delta <= 20%. If ANY gate trips, trigger automated rollback to previous stage and page oncall.

elaine: Add a quality gate: run a 100-sample output check against canonical prompts for semantic regression. If quality delta > 1.5% (metric = task-SIM or eval score), treat as gate fail.

sanju: Fallback policy design: tiered fallback with explicit reasons. Priority: dedicated-primary -> dedicated-readonly (if write-heavy queue overload) -> regional-shared -> global-shared. Each fallback reason logged as `route.reason` for traceability.

infra-bot: preflight-check: gpu-pool:OK; tag-kv:OK; autoscaler-hooks:registered; rollout-playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/tenant-priority-rollout.

mike: Detection rules for degradation: sustained queue length > 200 for 3m OR p99 > SLA_threshold for 5m OR sudden 429/503 spike > 30/min.

tess: Auto-cooling strategy: if fallback occurs, immediately cut current stage traffic by 60% for 15m, then reassess. After 30m stable, attempt a fractional roll-forward (+10%) capped at previous safe stage. All actions logged in #rollout-alerts.

sanju: A/B testing: do NOT split production customer traffic without consent. Use internal tenants and an opt-in friendly-customer cohort. A/B buckets: variant A -> Dedicated routing, variant B -> Shared routing. Track cost/quality delta and NPS signals.

elain: (typo?) I mean Elaine: We'll need customer comms templates for opt-ins and for billing implications. Tess can own that.

tess: On it. I'll prep two templates: 1) invitation to beta (technical changes + opt-in link), 2) transition notice (if we move them to Dedicated permanently, include SLA and billing bullets). ETA Wed EOD.

mike: Observability changes: add fields to traces/logs: `route.pool`, `route.variant`, `route.reason`, `flag.rev`. Also per-tenant cards in dashboard with daily cost trending and p99 time-series.

sanju: Config snippet for the flag (engineering-friendly):
```
{
  "flag_name": "ff/tenant_priority/v2",
  "selector": {"tag":"customer.labels.priority=high"},
  "stages": [
    {"id":"pilot","pct":"0.5","window":"12h","gates":["p99","errors","quality"]},
    {"id":"narrow","pct":"2","window":"12h"},
    {"id":"small","pct":"10","window":"24h"},
    {"id":"broad","pct":"50","window":"24h"},
    {"id":"full","pct":"100","window":"-"}
  ],
  "fallbacks": ["dedicated-readonly","regional-shared","global-shared"]
}
```

mike: Kill-switch ownership: engineering (infra) implements circuit-breaker hooks, oncall operates emergency kill. Product owns the staged approvals and customer messaging. Legal must sign off on billing text before full move.

elaine: Launch criteria checklist (short): preflight green, pilot pass for 12h, narrow pass for 12h, data quality checks pass, runbook and comms ready, legal & finance sign-off.

tess: Post-launch guardrails: weekly cost review for first 8 weeks, automated quality-eval daily, and a regression alert that auto-opens a P1 if quality drops > 2%.

infra-bot: deploy-schedule: pilot start at 2789012355 UTC Mon; monitor hooks active.

mike: Timeline: preflight this Fri, pilot Mon, narrow Tue, small Wed, broad Thu, hold Fri for executive review.

elaine: Action items:
- sanju: implement route.reason tag & auto-cooldown logic (ETA Wed)
- tess: comms + internal FAQ + opt-in form (ETA Wed)
- mike: finalize runbook edits & QA metrics dashboards (ETA Thu)
- legal/finance: approve billing blurb (ETA Thu)

tess: Will ping #rollout when templates are ready. :white_check_mark:

elaine: If anyone sees anomalies once pilot starts, immediate page the oncall. We'll reconvene after pilot metrics are in.

mike: ack. :rocket:
